places.name: Lonesome Dove
places.note: Hot, dusty border town in the chaparral where the Hat Creek Cattle Company keeps its house, lots and the Dry Bean saloon nearby.
places.location_hint: south Texas, on the north bank of the Rio Grande in chaparral flats; about twelve miles from Pickles Gap

places.name: Hat Creek
places.note: Nearly always-dry sandy creek by the outfit's wagon yard; a storm once washed the barn roof down it into the Rio Grande.
places.location_hint: runs past the Hat Creek Cattle Company yard at Lonesome Dove and drains into the Rio Grande

places.name: Rio Grande
places.note: Border river beside the town; the outfit crosses it at night to raid Mexican stock, and cattle get chased back and forth across it.

places.name: Mexico
places.note: Lies across the river; Call bought his biting mare there, and the partners ride in to steal horses and cattle.

places.name: Pickles Gap
places.note: Tiny settlement founded by a lost Georgian; Call claims it has good shade, Augustus scorns it as even worse than Lonesome Dove.
places.location_hint: about twelve miles from Lonesome Dove in the mesquite brush of south Texas

places.name: Georgia
places.note: Home of Wesley Pickles, founder of Pickles Gap.

places.name: Tennessee
places.note: Augustus, like the barber Dillard Brawley, is a Tennessean; whiskey makes him feel like a cool Tennessee morning.

places.name: Texas
places.note: Augustus thinks himself the only man in south Texas who can keep Call in proportion.

places.name: Brazos River
places.note: After Indians took their horses, the Rangers walked nearly two hundred miles down it, fearing Comanches.

places.name: Stone House
places.note: Site of a smoky Ranger battle with the Keechis where Pea Eye lost hearing in one ear and the horses were stolen.
places.location_hint: somewhere upriver on or near the Brazos in north-central Texas; Rangers walked about two hundred miles down the Brazos afterward

places.raw_name: the Prairie Dog Fork of the Red
places.name: Prairie Dog Town Fork Red River
places.note: Where Comanches trapped Call, Augustus and six Rangers in dug holes; Augustus argued about coon dogs all night before they slipped away.

places.name: Scotland
places.note: Augustus reminds Call he was born there and brought over as a baby.

groups.label: Hat Creek outfit
groups.hint: at the Hat Creek Cattle Company house in town
